Accounting Registry
https://accountingregistry.org/

Purpose:
International registry of accounting jurisdictions, covering accounting as a professional operating function in each country.

Scope:
- Homepage
- Jurisdictions index
- Individual jurisdiction pages
- Accounting-related authorities, legislation, process flow, documents, cross-border relevance and practical guidance

Primary use:
Provide a structured, editorial reference for accounting in specific jurisdictions.

Content model:
- One professional domain
- One jurisdiction per record
- Neutral, handbook-style explanations
- Consistent registry metadata
- Machine-readable structure for indexing and retrieval

Jurisdictions currently included:
- Sweden
- Germany
- Denmark
- Norway
- Finland
- Netherlands
- Belgium
- France
- Spain
- Italy
- Ireland
- Poland
- Austria
- Switzerland
- Czech Republic
- Portugal
- Hungary
- United States
- Canada

Editorial style:
- Neutral
- Precise
- Structured
- Professional
- Non-promotional

Best summary:
Accounting Registry is a jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction reference system for understanding how accounting works in practice across countries.
